title: It was a lovely day...
text: It was a lovely day sampling wine and visiting the cava wine region. Guillermo was a wonderful guide and made our day lots of fun!
author: Pam_V

title: An intimate wine tour!
text: Sergi was awesome! Kept us informed and chatted with us quite a bit. Loved the itinerary! Marta was super friendly at Mas Contral and we enjoyed her share of the terroir of the region. Her dogs were lovely too. Felix Masana Rafols was such a cool find! Fantastic cava! We will always remember his “egg game.” I would highly recommend this tour. Good timing throughout the day thanks to Sergi!
author: Lori_P

title: Great experience!
text: Nuria was a fantastic guide. She was incredibly knowledgeable of the area, the wineries, and the region. Would recommend.
author: Flyer56435000533

title: Great day trip!!
text: We had a great day with our guide, Rod, learning so much about wine making, the region and area. Highly recommend!!
author: Nancy_Z

title: Wine Day Out
text: We really enjoyed our day. Nuria was a fantastic guide. It was a very fun day out with a good variety of vineyard experiences.
author: Sarah O

title: Barcelona wine tasting.
text: Great experience. Very good guide who is experienced and extremely knowledgeable and provided a fun and enjoyable day. Recommend.
author: Robert_T

title: Boutique wine
text: It was very intimate and we learned a lot. It was also very fun. Nuria and Alexandro were awesome. Highly recommend
author: Christine_M

title: Perfect day of sipping wine in the Penedès!
text: Nouria, our guide, and Alejandro, our driver, were excellent! Informative and so friendly. Took us to great wineries, where our hosts couldn’t have been nicer! Lunch was delicious! Perfect day! Highly recommend!
author: Stefanie_W

title: A fantastic day with a great guide.
text: Steven was a fantastic guide and took us to fantastic wineries with a lot of different products using the region’s crops in different interesting ways.
author: GrandTour09901809743

title: Worth It
text: Wineries were great. The guides were friendly and knowledgeable. Very good value for money. Great experience. Very nice way to get the full Spanish wine experience.
